_comment: Northflank health-check config for the powerx service. Applied to the live service via PATCH /v1/projects/cdnai/services/combined/powerx. Kept here so the setting is reproducible instead of living only in the platform UI.
_why_no_liveness_probe: The liveness probe (HTTP /api/health on 8765) restarted the container on a fixed ~135s cycle in production: the app boots, binds 8765 and serves traffic correctly, but the probe never reached a passing state, so after initialDelaySeconds + failureThreshold*periodSeconds the platform killed and replaced the container -- repeatedly, which surfaced to users as a permanent 503 'no healthy upstream'. The startupProbe already gates readiness on the same port, so the liveness probe added no signal: the only thing it did was terminate a healthy process. It is intentionally omitted. Do not re-add it without first verifying that an unauthenticated GET /api/health returns 200 on the exposed port (8765) from inside the cluster.
